_why: Starting values for the Intercepta setup page. They live here, not in source, because npm run verify refuses a hardcoded endpoint in src/ or scripts/ — and because a value without its provenance is a value nobody can re-check.
_unconfirmed: Read before trusting anything here: we have not called this API yet. The host and the path below come from public documentation, and the auth header name is a guess. The response shape is entirely unknown, so no adapter may assume a field called clean or flagged. Confirmed values belong in Issue #14 with the raw curl output that produced them.

INTERCEPTA_BASE_URL.source: The API host named in the public reference the prize page points at, https://docs.web3antivirus.io — the Intercepta prize uses that domain as its own reference.

INTERCEPTA_SCAN_PATH.source: Quick Scan Address, the low-latency risk assessment. Deep Scan is a separate endpoint (.../toxic-score) and is the one documented as explaining sanctions, laundering and fraud flags — switch to it if Quick Scan will not give us a reason we can show a person.

INTERCEPTA_AUTH_HEADER.source: UNCONFIRMED — a guess, kept here rather than in code precisely so it is visible as one. Replace it with the header an actual 200 response required.

keys.source: Where the API reference lives. Sandbox keys come from the prize page's form: one key, 1,000 requests, valid through judging.
